hook: Did you know France and Spain alternate administration of Pheasant Island every 6 months?

sections.voiceover: Did you know France and Spain alternate administration of Pheasant Island every 6 months?
b_roll: graphic of map with alternating flags on a small island

sections.voiceover: In 1659, France and Spain signed the Treaty of the Pyrenees on Pheasant Island. Who controls Pheasant Island today?
b_roll: aerial graphic of Bidasoa River island

sections.voiceover: However, France doesn't keep permanent control because authority flips to Spain every 6 months.
b_roll: split screen showing French flag and Spanish flag

sections.voiceover: France and Spain alternate administration over the territory every 6 months. This shared border status has endured continuously since 1659.
b_roll: motion chart showing 6 month administrative timeline
diagram showing island surface area stabilization

sections.voiceover: France and Spain continue swapping Pheasant Island every 6 months.
